I am old now, 76 years, and this small maize plot near the house is only a tenth of a hectare. I save what manure I can from the animals and spread it there, because chemical fertilizer is too costly and the cooperative often brings it late. I plant the seed I kept from last harvest like my mother taught me, and my daughter-in-law helps me weed with the hoe. I cannot carry water, so I wait for the meher rains like always.
